title: Prevent local inference from passing remote provider connection test
context: DynamicActiveProvider prioritizes the local model when privacy.localOnly is enabled. Settings connection testing calls that same runtime, so a local completion could be incorrectly presented as proof that the selected remote provider works.
goal: Fail the remote provider connection test explicitly while local-only mode is enabled, rather than allowing local inference to produce a false remote success.
forbidden_changes: Do not disable or mutate the user's local-only privacy preference.
Do not make a network request while local-only mode is enabled.
Do not alter provider credential storage or runtime routing.
acceptance_criteria: The remote provider test fails before invoking the provider runtime when privacy.localOnly is true.
The failure explains that local-only mode blocks remote provider testing.
The new message is localized in English and Vietnamese.
The connection test records failure and does not report local inference as remote provider success.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Static duplicate-key scan for EN and VI catalogs
recovery: Revert the single task commit if the provider connection test mutates privacy settings or misreports remote availability.
